summary: Descartes Systems Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing interim financial statements and XBRL exhibits for the fiscal second quarter and six months ended July 31, 2026. The Canadian issuer's routine quarterly report includes balance sheet, income statement, equity and cash-flow data, plus segment revenue by service, license, professional services and geography. XBRL tags also disclose a Fiscal 2026 restructuring plan with severance and facility-closing costs, prior acquisitions, and two subsequent-event acquisitions: Transportation Applied Intelligence Software on August 21, 2026 and 3PL Central LLC on September 1, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium or deal terms are stated; this is an ordinary earnings filing, not a special situation.
